name: @copypaste/design-tokens
description: The single source of truth for CopyPaste colour, type, spacing and motion. Compiled by Style Dictionary to CSS custom properties.

scripts.check: npm run check:generated && node check-contrast.mjs && node check-usage.mjs && node check-android.mjs
scripts.check:generated: npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist ../crates/copypaste-ui/src-tauri/gen/android/app/src/main/res/values/colors.xml ../crates/copypaste-ui/src-tauri/gen/android/app/src/main/res/values/dimens.xml ../crates/copypaste-ui/src-tauri/gen/android/app/src/main/res/values-night/colors.xml
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run check
